messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
=] All in all-fabulous.Yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot.

output.original_text: All in all-fabulous.Yesterday, Sunday, I almost broke my foot.
output.joy: All in all, it was fabulous! I had such a fun time yesterday, even with my near foot injury!
output.sadness: All in all, it was fabulous, but yesterday was tough. I almost broke my foot, and it really hurt.
output.fear: All in all, it was fabulous... but I was terrified when I almost broke my foot yesterday!
output.anger: All in all, it was fabulous, but I'm so frustrated that I almost broke my foot yesterday!
output.surprise: All in all, it was fabulous! I can't believe I almost broke my foot yesterday!
output.disgust: All in all, it was fabulous, but what a gross scare yesterday! I almost broke my foot.
